meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会启动一个浏览器,并写小脚本分步操作网页:导航、点击、填表、截图、抓数据、测试站点;页面状态在多次脚本之间保留。
howto.when: 当你说“打开某网址”“填表”“截图”等浏览器交互请求时触发;也可选择连上你已登录的 Chrome。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com,告诉我标题和网址
say.note: 它会启动浏览器打开该页并读出标题、网址

say.text: 用我现有的 Chrome 登录这个网站,然后截图给我
say.note: 需先开启扩展模式并连接成功

say.text: 把这个列表页的数据抓下来
say.note: 大表可改用拦截网络请求重放的方式

howto.what_en: After install, Claude launches a browser and writes small scripts to act on web pages step by step — navigating, clicking, filling forms, taking screenshots, scraping data, testing sites. Page state persists across script runs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to open a URL, fill a form, take a screenshot, scrape, log in, or automate any browser interaction. Extension mode can connect to your existing Chrome.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and tell me the title and URL
say_en.note: It opens the page and reports title and URL

say_en.text: Log into this site using my existing Chrome, then screenshot it
say_en.note: Requires extension mode to connect first

say_en.text: Scrape the data from this listing page
say_en.note: For big tables it can replay network requests instead
